title: Normal-part integral bounded by the conical-excess integrand (book (1))
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, mu a measure on R^(n+l), P : R^(n+l) -> L(R^(n+l), R^(n+l)) an arbitrary map into continuous linear endomorphisms, y in R^(n+l) and s > 0. Then the Lebesgue integral of ofReal(|(x - y) - P(x)(x - y)|^2) over the closed ball B_s(y) is at most ofReal(s^(n+2)) times the Lebesgue integral of ofReal(|(x - y) - P(x)(x - y)|^2 / |x - y|^(n+2)) over B_s(y). Here the quotient is 0 at x = y (real division by 0 is 0), ofReal(t) = max(t, 0), integrals take values in [0, infinity], and no measurability is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (P : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - P x (x - y)‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ (n + 2)) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - P x (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂μ
